FUB-Automation.stack: Java 21 · Spring Boot · PostgreSQL · React · TypeScript
FUB-Automation.description: Automation Engine is a Follow Up Boss call-automation system built with a production-style architecture (controller → service → port → adapter → repository). It ingests signed webhook events, processes call outcomes asynchronously, and automatically creates follow-up tasks so teams can close the loop from missed calls to action. It also provides an operations-focused admin layer with live webhook ingestion, processed-call visibility, and replay for failed flows.

Careeros.stack: React · TypeScript · NestJS · FastAPI · RabbitMQ · PostgreSQL
Careeros.description: Careeros is an AI-powered resume intelligence platform focused on practical hiring outcomes. It analyzes resumes for ATS compatibility, scoring quality, and improvement opportunities, then delivers structured feedback through a full-stack product setup. The system is built as a multi-service architecture with a React frontend, NestJS BFF, and FastAPI AI service to support scalable analysis workflows and future automation layers.

Corvanta.description: Corvanta is an autonomous HR operations platform designed for real estate brokerages, where onboarding velocity and compliance accuracy are critical. It automates core HR workflows such as new-agent onboarding, licensing/compliance checks, and operational follow-through while maintaining clear execution visibility. The product runs on a two-backend architecture: an orchestration service for workflow control and an intelligence service for specialized task execution.

Spendora.title: Spendora TauriShell React
Spendora.description: Spendora is a desktop-first personal expense tracker built with a React UI, Tauri native shell, Rust local services, and a single-user SQLite database. Instead of relying on a remote backend, it runs an expense-api and background expense-worker directly on your machine, with Tauri managing start/stop/status of both processes. The architecture is designed for local-first performance, clear service lifecycle control, and a practical path for modular financial integrations.
